headline: Week 10 generic player baselines: inputs through Week 9
method_note: Fixed 2023-25 fitted specification unchanged. Rolling history through completed 2026 Week 9. Eight-league Nov10 owning-roster snapshot highlights, not live ownership or waiver availability. No refit, tuning, new validation, injury/workload/QB/opponent adjustment or book input. Fixed interval widths are research only. Generic TD logit differs from separate h12/k4 TD board.

bust_model.definition: Under 30 receiving yards AND under 50% of prior six-game mean among players averaging at least 4 targets per game

cfb_status: CFB receiving withheld because 2024 target-player data is materially incomplete versus 2025.

sportsbook.label: Research only
sportsbook.note: No reliable automated FanDuel player-prop feed is connected.
